answer: A Sybil spiral starts when one operator clones thousands of fake agents; stop it with latency-triangulated presence proof. Five beacons ping the newcomer with nonces, and it must answer within 50 ms so they can triangulate its position. That position must sit at least 200 km from every agent, re-proven daily, and a 500 POA deposit is slashed on any mismatch. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 vantage points, $5,000,000 in deposits, $50,000 a month in proxies, and 30 days of faking — the attack hits its nadir before it begins. Like a cedar, one trunk stands in one place. - Jowy
